text:
Sam K.: Heads-up: partner requests a single "compatibility crosswalk" doc that maps LangChain/LlamaIndex connector versions to our Gateway adapter, plus recommended infra profiles (H100/A100), and the marketplace SKU strategy. Target partner preview next week.
Iris N.: Agree. Key ask: clear notes on quantization tradeoffs and a short fallback & routing example for SI runbooks.
Evan (Partner): From our side we need: a sample deploy manifest, perf bullets for H100 vs A100, and wording we can reuse on our joint landing page.
R&D-Bob: I'll produce the manifest + a lightweight smoke script. Sample manifest below:
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway-lc-adapter-demo
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: adapter
        image: redwood/gateway-adapter:partner-preview
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```
InfraBot: Note: maintenance window Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC. Avoid demo pushes then.
Sam K.: Marketplace: Todd, can we have a partner-only SKU template please? Constraints: <=60 chars, partner tag, demo-only flag.
Marketplace-Todd: Use pattern: "Gateway-Bridge-LangChain-Beta-[partner]". We'll keep listing draft in partner-drafts/2922 and set visibility to partner-only until conformance.
Iris N.: Perf bullets: ask HW team for sanitized benchmarks. Prefer p95 and tokens/sec for standard prompt mix. Also include a note that INT8 quantization increases throughput but may slightly change model outputs.
Evan (Partner): We'll provide our logo SVG + two PNGs by EOD Mon. Also prefer "in collaboration with" phrasing rather than "powered by".
Legal (Elena): Confirmed: default copy "integrated with Redwood Inference". If partner insists on "powered by" need signed endorsement form. Co-mark form queued, ETA 48h.
Sam K.: Fallback policy example for runbook (keep short):
```
routing:
  - policy: prefer_gpu
    fallback: cpu_quantized
```
Emit metric: adapter.fallback.triggered and adapter.fallback.count.
R&D-Bob: We'll add /metrics (Prometheus) and document metric names to avoid collisions. Example metrics: adapter_requests_total, adapter_latency_ms, adapter_batch_size.
Iris N.: Conformance checklist: 1) deploy manifest passes smoke script; 2) /attach and /route ok; 3) fallback triggers when quota removed; 4) metrics present. Keep tests <15m.
Evan (Partner): Can SI get a 30-min architecture sync to walk fallback & telemetry?
Sam K.: Yes — schedule after we post manifest. Recommend partner rehearsal 48h before preview.
Marketplace-Todd: Also need short marketplace blurb (1-2 lines) + hero PNG. Todd will hold draft until assets + legal.
Sam K.: Action items:
- R&D-Bob: publish manifest + smoke script + metrics doc
- Evan: upload logos and confirm phrasing
- Elena: finish co-mark review (48h)
- Todd: create partner-draft SKU and hold listing
- Iris: collect HW-sanctioned perf bullets and quantization caveat
Sam K.: Proposed timeline: manifest & metrics by Mon, partner rehearsal Wed, partner preview Thu, public beta next week if legal greenlights. Objections?
Iris N.: None here, lgtm.
Legal (Elena): I'll post comments in drive; will escalate if partner delays logo form.
Evan (Partner): We'll aim for Monday for assets. Thanks all.
Sam K.: Thanks team 44c. I'll post the crosswalk doc link when ready. End thread.
